mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM iam_tenant WHERE AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM iam_tenant WHERE AND status != 'ACTIVE'

SELECT feature_code FROM iam_tenant_feature WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enabled = true AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= now()) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > now()) ORDER BY feature_code
SELECT count(*) FROM iam_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM iam_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT count(*) FROM iam_role r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_role_permission rp JOIN iam_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE rp.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.deleted_at IS NULL )
